items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: And when I decided to do something for myself, and I asked Marshall, I said, well, look, I want to put it out. I'm not gonna put it out unless you give me half of the publishing.

ctx.x: And sure enough, that's what the man did. Took it off. Wanting some money. So, I went to Marshall. I said, Marshall, I said, we got a chance to get this record going. I said, you know, come on with something. And Marshall wouldn't come up with nothing. And I went back over there and I talked to him to try to get him to put it back on and let it stay on. So, I re-re- so what I did, I went to Marshall. And when I decided to do something for myself, and I asked Marshall, I said, well, look, I want to put it out. I'm…
Oh, he wanted it all? I mean, I think-
